name: RiffBox
_comment: Instrument: electric guitar chords per note (extended Karplus-Strong strings, the principle of DISTRHO Kars / karplong) into five amp models, aftertouch, delay. vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is riffbox_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
